**Finding: AUDIT — compliant (no redline proposed).**

The document imposes no audit, inspection, verification, or usage-monitoring right on us:

- **§ 21.8(C) (p0277)** — audit obligation runs *against M&I*: it must procure an annual independent third-party review of its own data processing centre and Operations Center and give us the report free of charge, plus implement recommended changes.
- **§ 21.8(B) (p0276)** and **§ 17.1 (p0243)** — regulator/auditor examination of M&I-held records and Customer Data, for our regulators' benefit, with M&I notice duties to us.
- **§ 21.8 (p0274)** — subjects M&I's performance to examination by *our* regulatory agencies.
- **§ 21.7(C) (p0273)** — only a books-and-records reflection covenant with evidence on request; not a right for M&I to audit our usage, fees, or systems.

Targeted searches for audit/inspection/verification, monitoring, certification-of-compliance, and underpayment/shortfall mechanics returned nothing running against us, and there is no remote or on-site access to our systems for audit purposes. With no vendor audit right to constrain, the frequency, notice, independent-auditor, cost-allocation and no-system-access parameters have nothing to bind, so the rule is satisfied and we should not volunteer audit machinery that does not currently exist.
